Studio product photograph of one garment on a plain wooden hanger, against a seamless light gray background (#F3F3F3), vertical 4:5, centered with generous margins, soft even e-commerce light, gentle natural shadow, real fabric texture, never CGI.
The garment is exactly the hoodie the man wears in IMAGE 1: a cream-white heavy fleece zip-up hoodie, cropped and boxy, with dropped shoulders, ribbed cuffs and hem, kangaroo pockets split by the silver zip, the hood lying flat behind the hanger, zipped halfway. Same color, fabric, length and volume as in image 1.
IMAGE 2 is only the reference for how the product photos of this series look: hanger, background, framing and light. Copy nothing else from it.
No person, no T-shirt, no chains, no logo, no text, no tag, no watermark.
